source("R/config.R")
source("R/load.R")
desc <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "descriptive.rds"))
cv <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "course_view.rds"))
res <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "baseline.rds"))
pan <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "panel.rds"))
sus <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "suspects.rds"))
cal <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "calibration.rds"))
bl <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "backtest_baselines.rds"))
mo <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "models.rds"))
sel <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "select.rds"))
fc <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "forecast.rds"))
bj <- readRDS(file.path(config$results_dir, "box_jenkins.rds"))
n_small <- desc$n_sites - length(desc$big_sites)
read_table <- function(name) read.csv(file.path(config$tables_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))

num <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  format(round(x, digits), big.mark = "\u00a0", decimal.mark = ",", nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE)
}
# Percentages; signed = TRUE writes +3,2 % or −1,7 % (Unicode minus).
pct <- function(x, digits = 0, signed = FALSE) {
  s <- num(abs(100 * x), digits)
  sign <- ifelse(x < 0, "−", if (signed) "+" else "")
  paste0(sign, s, "\u00a0%")
}
dec <- function(x, digits = 2) ifelse(x < 0, paste0("−", num(-x, digits)), num(x, digits))
fr_date <- function(d) format(d, "%d/%m/%Y")
fr_month <- function(d) format(d, "%m/%Y")
# Typst only reads files under report/, so each figure is copied from
# outputs/figures to report/_figures (not versioned) before being included.
fig <- function(name) {
  file <- paste0(name, ".png")
  dir.create(file.path("report", "_figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  stopifnot(file.copy(file.path(config$figures_dir, file), file.path("report", "_figures", file),
                      overwrite = TRUE))
  knitr::include_graphics(file.path("_figures", file), error = FALSE)
}

# Lists of the Q1 (scripts/04_suspects.R).
lf <- sus$list_facts
lst <- function(l, col) lf$lists[lf$lists$list == l, col]
err_kwh_share <- (lst("error", "over_kwh") - lst("error", "under_kwh")) / lf$kwh_ordinary
fa_expected <- cal$chosen$fa * lf$n_bills_ordinary  # false alerts at the simulated rate

# Big sites: per-site MASE (validation: models.rds, test: forecast.rds), kWh
# errors on the test months and the per-day naive for December 2021.
season_site <- config$arima_season_sites
other_big <- setdiff(fc$big, season_site)
site_mase <- function(data, site, method) mean(data$scaled_error[data$site == site & data$method == method])
big_test <- fc$test[fc$test$site %in% fc$big, ]
big_kwh_err <- tapply(abs(big_test$error), big_test$method, sum)  # both sites, 6 months
last_bills <- pan$panel[pan$panel$month == max(pan$panel$month), ]
naive_dec <- function(s) last_bills$kwh[last_bills$site == s] / last_bills$month_days[last_bills$site == s] * 31
dec_of <- function(s) fc$december$forecast[fc$december$site == s]
stopifnot(abs(dec_of(other_big) / naive_dec(other_big) - 1) < 1e-6)  # its ARIMA is the naive
